description: Searches Spanish companies (sociedades) by name or part of the name and returns up to 10 candidates with their tax ID (CIF), province and registry status. Use it when you do not have the CIF of a company; then call get_company with the chosen CIF. Sole traders (autónomos) are not included.

query.description: Company name or part of it

name: search_companies
title: Search Spanish companies by name
